_note: 學習路徑內容第22批 #5／6：倍數比較 twice／three times as…as（eng.t_adv.adjadv.multiple-comparison，學測級／高階）。倍數（twice／three times／half）放在 as…as 之前（twice as long as）；接名詞時可數用 as many…as、不可數用 as much…as；half as…as 表一半。誘答鎖『as…as 中間誤用比較級／漏掉 as／語序顛倒／可數不可數錯配／倍數詞語意顛倒』等唯一正解；刻意避開 three times -er than 這類有爭議用法以免理由誇大。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix mcp_）。

units.can_do: 我能用倍數（twice／three times／half）放在 as…as 之前表達倍數關係，並在接名詞時依可數／不可數選用 as many…as 或 as much…as。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Multiples go in front of 'as ... as', with the adjective in its base form: 'twice as big as', 'three times as fast as.'
claims.verification_ref: 倍數放在 as…as 前、中間用原級（twice as big as、three times as fast as）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: With nouns, use 'as many ... as' for countable nouns and 'as much ... as' for uncountable nouns: 'twice as many books as', 'three times as much water as.'
claims.verification_ref: 接名詞：可數 as many…as、不可數 as much…as（twice as many books as / three times as much water as）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'twice' is normally used with 'as ... as' ('twice as tall as'); 'twice taller than' is not standard.
claims.verification_ref: twice 常配 as…as（twice as tall as）、twice taller than 非標準；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'half' works the same way to mean a smaller amount: 'half as expensive as', 'half as heavy as.'
claims.verification_ref: half 同樣用 as…as 表一半（half as expensive as、half as heavy as）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: To say how many TIMES bigger, faster, etc., put the multiple (twice, three times...) before 'as ... as', and keep the adjective in its base form. This bridge is twice as long as that one.
teach.zh_hint: 要表達『幾倍大、幾倍快』等，把倍數（twice、three times…）放在 as…as 前面，中間的形容詞用原級。例：This bridge is twice as long as that one.（這座橋是那座的兩倍長。）

teach.body: This bridge is twice as long as that one.
teach.zh_hint: 這座橋是那座的兩倍長。twice as long as 表兩倍長。

teach.body: With nouns, use 'as many ... as' for countable nouns and 'as much ... as' for uncountable nouns. I have three times as many stickers as you.
teach.zh_hint: 接名詞時，可數名詞用 as many…as、不可數名詞用 as much…as。例：I have three times as many stickers as you.（我的貼紙是你的三倍多。）

teach.body: I have three times as many stickers as you.
teach.zh_hint: 我的貼紙是你的三倍多。可數名詞 stickers 用 as many…as。

teach.body: Use 'twice as ... as', not 'twice taller than'. 'half as ... as' means a smaller amount. This book is half as heavy as that one.
teach.zh_hint: 用 twice as…as，不說 twice taller than；half as…as 表示一半。例：This book is half as heavy as that one.（這本書是那本的一半重。）

teach.body: This book is half as heavy as that one.
teach.zh_hint: 這本書是那本的一半重。half as heavy as 表一半重。

practice.stem: 選正確：Your room is twice ____ mine.（你的房間是我的兩倍大）

distractor_rationales.as bigger as: as…as 中間用原級 big，不用比較級 bigger。
distractor_rationales.big as: 漏掉前面的 as；倍數比較要用完整的 as…as：twice as big as。
distractor_rationales.so big as: 表倍數用 as…as；so…as 多用於否定句，且不配 twice 表倍數。

practice.feedback: twice as big as mine：倍數 + as + 原級 + as。

practice.stem: 選正確：She read three times ____ books as her brother this year.（她今年讀的書是弟弟的三倍多）

distractor_rationales.as much: books 是可數名詞，用 as many…as，不用 as much。
distractor_rationales.more: 要表『三倍』用 three times as many…as，不是單純 more。
distractor_rationales.as more: as…as 中間用原級、可數用 many；沒有 as more 的用法。

practice.feedback: three times as many books as…：可數名詞用 as many…as。

practice.stem: 選正確：This plant needs twice ____ water as that one.（這株植物需要的水是那株的兩倍）

distractor_rationales.as many: water 是不可數名詞，用 as much…as，不用 as many。
distractor_rationales.more: 要表『兩倍』用 twice as much…as，不是單純 more。
distractor_rationales.as more: 沒有 as more 的用法；不可數用 as much…as。

practice.feedback: twice as much water as…：不可數名詞用 as much…as。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（這條路是那條的三倍長）
practice.answer: This road is three times as long as that one.
options: This road is three times as long as that one.
This road is three times long as that one.
This road is as long three times as that one.
This road is three times as longer as that one.

distractor_rationales.This road is three times long as that on: 倍數比較要用完整的 as…as：three times as long as，不能漏掉前面的 as。
distractor_rationales.This road is as long three times as that: 語序錯誤；倍數 three times 要放在 as long as 之前：three times as long as。
distractor_rationales.This road is three times as longer as th: as…as 中間用原級 long，不用比較級 longer。

practice.feedback: three times as long as…：倍數放前、as…as 中間用原級。

practice.stem: 選正確：My bag is ____ as heavy as yours; yours is much heavier.（我的包包只有你的一半重）

distractor_rationales.twice: twice 表兩倍，但句意是『一半重、你的重很多』，要用 half。
distractor_rationales.double: double 表兩倍，與『一半重』相反。
distractor_rationales.three times: three times 表三倍，與『一半重』相反。

practice.feedback: half as heavy as yours：half as…as 表一半。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Our new house is twice as big as the old one.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：twice as big as、the old one、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。as…as 連讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: This phone costs twice as much as that one.
lines.intonation: twice as much as 連讀、one 句尾下收

lines.text: I have half as many coins as my sister.
lines.intonation: half as many 連讀、sister 句尾下收
